_comment: Atlas Search index definition used by src/controllers/searchController.js.
Create this index named exactly 'default' on BOTH the 'teams' and 'players'
collections - $search resolves to the 'default' index when no index name is
given, and the search page queries both collections the same way.
Atlas UI: Database > Search > Create Search Index > JSON Editor.
Without these indexes the search route errors while the rest of the site works.
